title: SAP BusinessObjects Weekly Active User Trend
app: SAP BusinessObjects auditing data store via DB Connect and CMS/APS logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=businessobjects:audit
| timechart span=1w dc(user_name) as active_users
| eventstats avg(active_users) as avg_users
| eval below_trend=if(active_users<avg_users*0.85,1,0)
description: Trends the number of distinct weekly active users of SAP BusinessObjects and flags weeks where engagement drops below trend, an early signal of eroding adoption or an access problem.
value: Adoption is the return on a BI investment; a declining active-user trend for SAP BusinessObjects surfaces churn before a renewal or rationalisation review.
implementation: Ingest SAP BusinessObjects usage/activity events; schedule weekly and review adoption dips with the platform owner.
visualization: Timechart of SAP BusinessObjects weekly active users with trend band.
grandmaExplanation: We track how many people actually use SAP BusinessObjects each week so a drop in usage is noticed early.
